verdict.rationale: Issuing credentials to programmatic clients is a fair question for a government e-filing and payment service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only User ID/password login to the eFile and Pay system, an authenticated interactive login shell, XML schema packages and batch enrollment files obtained by email request. Nothing documents issuing API keys or tokens, and nothing documents scoped or least-privilege credentials for an automated agent. The 'agents' in the evidence are human tax agents managing client accounts, not delegated AI-agent credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
